subject.text: My password is suddenly always wrong

description.text: This morning I couldn't log in to my laptop. It says my password is wrong, but it worked yesterday.
A small light marked A on the keyboard stays on.
I've tried five times already. Is the laptop broken?

history.text: Last month: this laptop passed the routine check, all components healthy.

explanation: The A light means Caps Lock is on, so every letter typed becomes a capital. The laptop is healthy; just guide Sari to turn off Caps Lock and type again.
hints: What changed since yesterday? Look at the lights on the keyboard.
The light marked A is Caps Lock. What does it do to a password?
